summary_1line: Yudhishthira completes the Ashvamedha sacrifice, ritually offers the horse, distributes immense gifts, and even symbolically gives the Earth to the Brahmanas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Priests surround the divided sacrificial horse as Draupadi sits beside it while ritual fires blaze and chant-filled air rises upward.
Golden sacrificial stakes and altars glitter while priests pour offerings into the fire and musicians and celestial beings gather around the grand rite.
King Yudhishthira stands before assembled Brahmanas and kings, declaring he gives away the entire Earth as sacrificial gift.
